requested_cents (35000) <= net_cents (80000) → not REJECT
requested_cents (35000) > approved limit (30000) → MANUAL

net_cents = paid_cents - successful refunds + successful reversals = 30000 - 8000 + 0 = 22000

requested_cents (25000) > net_cents (22000) → REJECT
